notes: Owner build only: Sigrid de L'Azur joins Roscaelifer, researched with Google AI Mode and the wiki. The fifth-generation Deputy Director of the Airspace Patrol and Lindverne's adjutant, a Horse Thiren knight (ears that swivel, a tail that swishes), formal and earnest ("Glory guides us onward!"), secretly worried she doesn't live up to her own legend. She always keeps an eye on Lindverne: two steps behind on patrol, the next table over at lunch, turning up at Boom Scones with the paperwork. Off duty she knits, bakes, sneaks pancakes at Roarin' Brekkies, gets lost following GPS, and has a loud, goofy laugh she's mortified by. Birthday April 23.
